# NeuroFairy curriculum

This is the learning path for building NeuroFairy. Each stage now has one folder containing
its instructions and recovery checkpoints, so you do not need to search across the
repository.

**Recommended next file:** [Stage 1 — Understand the working local app](stage-01-local-app/README.md)

## How to use this curriculum

1. Open only the `README.md` for your current stage.
2. Complete one session at a time and run its verification commands.
3. Open a checkpoint only if you are stuck or want to compare complete files.

## How checkpoints work

Checkpoints are recovery references, not extra lessons or required reading.

- `checkpoints/session-01.md` shows the expected result after Session 1.
- Later session files show only the complete files and output relevant at that point.
- `checkpoints/final/README.md` explains the finished stage snapshot.
- `checkpoints/final/complete-code/` contains complete reference files for recovery.

Stay in the stage `README.md` while learning. If your result works and its checks pass, you
do not need to open the checkpoint.

## Stages

| Stage | Status | What you finish with |
|---|---|---|
| [1. Working local app](stage-01-local-app/README.md) | Current foundation | A verified browser → FastAPI → local Ollama chat slice |
| [2. Desktop Fairy](stage-02-desktop-fairy/README.md) | **Next priority** | A draggable, hoverable, clickable macOS Fairy |
| [3. Tasks and next actions](stage-03-tasks/README.md) | Planned | One shared task source across services and interfaces |
| [4. Daily planning](stage-04-daily-planning/README.md) | Planned | Brain dump → realistic plan → one next action |
| [5. Gentle focus](stage-05-focus/README.md) | Planned | Shared body-doubling focus sessions |
| [6. Safe AI tools](stage-06-ai-tools/README.md) | Planned | Typed, limited, observable LangChain tools |
| [7. Read-only connectors](stage-07-connectors/README.md) | Later | Consent-based calendar and connector context |
| [8. Charms and pilot](stage-08-charms-and-pilot/README.md) | Deferred | Non-punitive rewards, evaluation, and pilot readiness |
